lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible on the lateral flank posterior to the branchial region, though contrast is significantly attenuated by medium turbidity.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern along the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher pixel values on the dorsal edge and lower values (shadow) on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark, elongated silhouettes (consistent with remoras) attached to the ventral surface and the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
